ingredientSections.heading: Beet, Gorgonzola & Pistachio Pizza
items: Heirloom tomato and birdseye chilli sauce

ingredientSections.heading: Beet, Gorgonzola & Pistachio Pizza with Pickled Red Onion
steps: Beer Pairing: Bridge Brewing All Out Stout.
Scrub beets and wrap in foil. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for approximately 45-60 minutes or until tender. Once cool, remove the skins with a knife and slice beets into thin slices.
Preheat oven to 220°C (425F). Generously spread tomato sauce onto flatbread. Line with slices of red and golden beet. Scatter gorgonzola and pistachios and top with dollops of farmers cheese.
Place on oven rack and bake for 10 minutes or until crispy around the edges. Top with a sparing amount of pickled red onion.
